description: Elections Commission - Notify the name of R. M. J. Rathnayake as a member to the Uhana Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Uhana Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, which is a core electoral process matter. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member by a political party under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it clearly related to electoral administration.
